about: Lines shown under the day in the Case Log app. c = when: or (days with cases), clinic (weekdays with no cases), off (weekends), empty (any day with no cases), any (every day). Added to monthly.

quotes.t: No cases today. Even the discs get a day off.
Rest is part of fusion. Ask any bone graft.
Today’s only alignment goal is your own posture.
Empty schedule, open foramen. Breathe easy.
The spine has 33 vertebrae and zero of them are on the schedule today.
Good surgeons know when to operate. Great ones know when to go golfing.
Nothing to decompress today except you.
A quiet OR day keeps the PACU nurses happy.
Bones heal on their own schedule. Today, so do you.
No retractors today. Stand up straight anyway.
No surgery today. Clinic is just surgery with more talking.
Clinic: where “it’s been hurting for 20 years” is always urgent today.
Today’s procedure: 34 patients, one bathroom break.
Clinic day. Hydrate, caffeinate, explain the MRI again.
Somewhere a patient is bringing a binder. Godspeed.
“Dr. Google said it was a tumor.” It was a muscle strain.
Every clinic has one patient who brings their own MRI report, highlighted.
Clinic runs on coffee and the phrase “let’s get some imaging.”
The patient who “only has one quick question” has seven.
Pain 10 out of 10, while eating chips in the waiting room.
“I read online I need a fusion.” You read wrong.
Allergies: penicillin, latex, and physical therapy.
No cases today. Somewhere out there a herniated disc is waiting for you.
Empty OR. Time to go find some stenosis.
The schedule is empty, but the MRI reader is full.
Today we scout. Tomorrow we decompress.
The best operation is sometimes the one you talk someone out of.
Treat the patient, not the MRI.
Good outcomes start with good indications.
Every spine you fix belongs to someone’s whole life.
Measure twice, burr once.
Neuromonitoring is quiet. Keep it that way.
Confirm the level on fluoro. Then confirm it again.
Retractors in, phones down, music up.
The PLL is more of a suggestion.
Good hemostasis is a love language.
Healthy bleeding subchondral bone. Today’s mood.
Excellent purchase on every screw. Check the AP anyway.
